name: Tibet Rhodiola Pharmaceutical Holding Co.
summary: Tibet Rhodiola Pharmaceutical Holding Co. produces and sells pharmaceutical products in China and internationally. The company offers modern Tibetan Medicines, including Nodikang capsules and granules, snow mountain golden arhat pain relief film, and ten-flavor Tida capsules; modern Chinese medicines, such as children Shuangqing granules, lipid clearing capsules, ginseng and zhi capsules, puyu capsules, and epilepsy flat film; and recombinant human brain natriuretic peptide for injection.
